title.en: bayern – magdeburg im kilians.

line.en: dfb-pokal, second round, kick-off 20:45 on ard. every screen at the irish pub by the frauenkirche; come at 20:15 for a table.
line.de: dfb-pokal, zweite runde, anstoß 20:45 in der ard. im irish pub an der frauenkirche laufen alle bildschirme; um 20:15 kommen, dann gibt es noch einen tisch.
line.tr: dfb-pokal ikinci tur, vuruş 20:45, ard'de. frauenkirche yanındaki irish pub'ta her ekranda maç var; masa için 20:15'te gel.

sparks.why: FC Bayern vs 1. FC Magdeburg, DFB-Pokal round 2, Wed 28.10 20:45 at the Allianz Arena, free-TV on ARD (fussballnationalmannschaft.net, 90min.de; one older calendar said 19:45). Rain all day — indoors.

title.en: rain today, so grill under a roof.
title.de: regen heute, also grillen unter dach.
title.tr: bugün yağmur var, mangal çatı altında.

line.en: the isar is wet and dark by five. take the grill indoors: a covered terrace, a courtyard with a roof, bring the sausages.
line.de: die isar ist nass und ab fünf dunkel. grillen drinnen: überdachte terrasse, hof mit dach, würstchen mitbringen.
line.tr: ısar ıslak ve beşte karanlık. mangalı içeri al: örtülü teras, çatılı avlu, sosisleri getir.

sparks.why: Rain and 7–13°C on Wednesday 28.10 (wetter.com, DWD) — outdoor grill moves under a roof; sunset 17:02.

title.en: a wet forest walk in the perlacher forst.
title.tr: perlacher forst'ta ıslak bir orman yürüyüşü.

line.en: rain jackets, wet leaves and nobody else around. an easy loop through the forest on the southeast edge of the city, back for soup.
line.de: regenjacke, nasses laub und sonst niemand da. eine leichte runde durch den wald am südöstlichen stadtrand, danach suppe.
line.tr: yağmurluk, ıslak yapraklar, etrafta kimse yok. şehrin güneydoğusunda ormanda kolay bir tur, sonra çorba.

sparks.why: Rain and 7–13°C on Wednesday 28.10 (wetter.com, DWD) — light rain, mild enough for a rain-jacket walk; the Olympiaberg is slippery.

title.en: grey dawn from the olympiaberg, if it clears.
title.de: graue dämmerung vom olympiaberg, wenn es aufreißt.

line.en: sunrise is at 06:52 but the sky is shut. go anyway at 06:32, bring a thermos; if it's all cloud, breakfast is the plan b.
line.de: sonnenaufgang ist um 06:52, aber der himmel ist zu. trotzdem um 06:32 los, thermoskanne mit; bei dichten wolken ist frühstück plan b.
line.tr: gün doğumu 06:52 ama gökyüzü kapalı. yine de 06:32'de çık, termos al; bulut varsa plan b kahvaltı.

sparks.why: Rain and 7–13°C on Wednesday 28.10 (wetter.com, DWD) — sunrise 06:52 minus 20 minutes; heavy cloud so likely no colour — breakfast as fallback.

title.en: a long breakfast while it rains.

line.en: a wednesday with rain is a breakfast day. a window seat, a second coffee, nowhere to be until noon.
line.de: ein mittwoch mit regen ist ein frühstückstag. fensterplatz, zweiter kaffee, bis mittag nichts vor.
line.tr: yağmurlu bir çarşamba kahvaltı günüdür. cam kenarı, ikinci kahve, öğlene kadar acelen yok.

sparks.why: Rain and 7–13°C on Wednesday 28.10 (wetter.com, DWD) — rain from the morning makes a long café breakfast the sensible plan.

title.en: a rooftop view from under cover.

line.en: no golden hour in this rain. the view from a covered rooftop bar at dusk, sunset 17:02, a hot drink in hand.
line.de: kein goldenes licht bei dem regen. der blick von einer überdachten dachbar zur dämmerung, sonnenuntergang 17:02, heißes getränk in der hand.
line.tr: bu yağmurda altın saat yok. alacakaranlıkta örtülü bir çatı barından manzara, gün batımı 17:02, elde sıcak bir içecek.

sparks.why: Rain and 7–13°C on Wednesday 28.10 (wetter.com, DWD) — clouds and rain, so a covered viewpoint instead of an open roof; sunset 17:02.

title.en: an evening swim in a real pool.

line.en: too cold and wet for the lakes. the jugendstil hall of the volksbad, warm water, then the sauna floor if you want.
line.de: für die seen zu kalt und nass. die jugendstil-halle des volksbads, warmes wasser, danach gern die sauna.
line.tr: göller için fazla soğuk ve ıslak. volksbad'ın art nouveau salonu, sıcak su, istersen sonra sauna.

sparks.why: Rain and 7–13°C on Wednesday 28.10 (wetter.com, DWD) — max 13°C, so an indoor pool only.

title.en: pub quiz while the cup is on.

line.en: bayern play at 20:45, so quiz early: teams of four, three rounds from 20:00, then the match on the big screen.
line.de: bayern spielt um 20:45, also quiz früh: vierer-teams, drei runden ab 20:00, danach das spiel auf der leinwand.
line.tr: bayern 20:45'te oynuyor, o yüzden quiz erken: dörtlü takımlar, 20:00'den üç tur, sonra büyük ekranda maç.

sparks.why: Bayern vs Magdeburg kicks off 20:45 (DFB-Pokal), so the quiz goes early; rain keeps it indoors.

title.en: one place you have never been, indoors.
title.de: ein ort, an dem du noch nie warst, drinnen.
title.tr: hiç gitmediğin bir yer, ama içeride.

line.en: the rain is a good reason for a corner of the city you skipped: a bar, a bakery, a shop with a back room. pick one on the way home.
line.de: der regen ist ein guter grund für eine ecke der stadt, die du ausgelassen hast: bar, bäckerei, laden mit hinterzimmer. such dir unterwegs eine aus.
line.tr: yağmur, atladığın bir köşe için iyi bir bahane: bir bar, bir fırın, arka odası olan bir dükkan. eve dönerken birini seç.

sparks.why: Rain and 7–13°C on Wednesday 28.10 (wetter.com, DWD) — generic new-place spark, kept indoors.

title.en: photo walk in the wet streets.

line.en: wet cobbles, shop windows and umbrellas reflect everything. dull light, but it suits the lens. go before it's dark at 17:02.
line.de: nasses pflaster, schaufenster und schirme spiegeln alles. mattes licht, aber es steht dem objektiv gut. los vor der dunkelheit um 17:02.
line.tr: ıslak kaldırım taşları, vitrinler, şemsiyeler her şeyi yansıtıyor. donuk ışık ama objektife yakışıyor. 17:02'de hava kararmadan çık.

sparks.why: Rain and 7–13°C on Wednesday 28.10 (wetter.com, DWD) — overcast with rain gives reflections; sunset 17:02.

title.en: no festival today, so make one.
title.de: heute kein festival, also mach eins.

line.en: nothing big on in town this wednesday. bring friends, a speaker and snacks to a flat, and call it a festival.
line.de: an diesem mittwoch ist in der stadt nichts großes los. freunde, box und snacks in eine wohnung, fertig ist das festival.
line.tr: bu çarşamba şehirde büyük bir şey yok. arkadaşlar, hoparlör, atıştırmalık bir eve, adı festival olsun.

sparks.why: No festival or market found for Wed 28.10 (Tollwood summer ended in July; Museum Night was 17.10); concerts at Zenith and Feierwerk only (mvp.de).

title.en: karaoke after the match.

line.en: the cup tie ends around 22:40. a karaoke bar until late, one song each, no judging.
line.de: das pokalspiel ist gegen 22:40 vorbei. eine karaokebar bis spät, jeder ein lied, niemand bewertet.
line.tr: kupa maçı 22:40 civarı biter. geç saate kadar açık bir karaoke bar, herkes bir şarkı, kimse yargılamaz.

sparks.why: Midweek, rain; Bayern match ends about 22:40 so karaoke is the late option for those skipping it.

title.en: crate digging out of the rain.

line.en: a record shop is the driest hobby there is. flick through the crates, buy one blind, listen to it at home.
line.de: ein plattenladen ist das trockenste hobby überhaupt. kisten durchblättern, eine blind kaufen, zu hause hören.
line.tr: plak dükkanı en kuru hobidir. kutuları karıştır, birini körlemesine al, evde dinle.

sparks.why: Rain and 7–13°C on Wednesday 28.10 (wetter.com, DWD) — indoor browsing suits the weather.

title.en: no open air today, only umbrellas.
title.de: kein open air heute, nur schirme.
title.tr: bugün açık hava yok, sadece şemsiye.

line.en: the olympiasee is grey and wet. if you want outside, go for a short loop with a hood up, then somewhere warm.
line.de: der olympiasee ist grau und nass. wer raus will: kurze runde mit kapuze, danach irgendwo warm.
line.tr: olympiasee gri ve ıslak. dışarı çıkacaksan kapüşonla kısa bir tur at, sonra sıcak bir yere.

sparks.why: Rain and 7–13°C on Wednesday 28.10 (wetter.com, DWD) — open-air events are off; a short wet loop at best.

title.en: a rain-proof ride along the isar.
title.de: eine regenfeste runde an der isar.
title.tr: ısar boyunca yağmura dayanıklı bir sürüş.

line.en: mudguards on, lights on. the isar path is empty in the rain; ride to the flaucher and back before the dark at five.
line.de: schutzbleche dran, licht an. der isarradweg ist im regen leer; zum flaucher und zurück, bevor es um fünf dunkel wird.
line.tr: çamurluk takılı, ışıklar açık. yağmurda ısar yolu bomboş; beşte hava kararmadan flaucher'e git ve dön.

sparks.why: Rain and 7–13°C on Wednesday 28.10 (wetter.com, DWD) — light rain only, 13°C at best; ride early, sunset 17:02.

title.en: a film instead of the cup.

line.en: a proper cinema, a dark room and no football. original-language screenings run in the evening at the arthouse cinemas.
line.de: ein richtiges kino, ein dunkler saal und kein fußball. originalfassungen laufen abends in den programmkinos.
line.tr: gerçek bir sinema, karanlık bir salon ve futbolsuz. orijinal dil gösterimleri akşamları sanat sinemalarında.

sparks.why: Rain and 7–13°C on Wednesday 28.10 (wetter.com, DWD) — cinema is the obvious rain plan; programme to be checked on the day.

title.en: board games and a long table.
title.tr: kutu oyunları ve uzun bir masa.

line.en: a game café with a shelf of two thousand boxes. rain outside, tea on the table, one long game.
line.de: ein spielecafé mit einem regal voller zweitausend schachteln. draußen regen, tee auf dem tisch, ein langes spiel.
line.tr: iki bin kutu dolu bir rafı olan bir oyun kafe. dışarıda yağmur, masada çay, uzun bir oyun.

sparks.why: Rain and 7–13°C on Wednesday 28.10 (wetter.com, DWD) — classic rain-day indoor plan.

title.en: a wet flea market, bargains in the rain.
title.tr: yağmurda bir bit pazarı, ucuz bulmaca.

line.en: fewer sellers when it rains, so better prices. check the covered stalls and go before noon.
line.de: bei regen sind weniger händler da, dafür bessere preise. die überdachten stände ansehen und vor mittag gehen.
line.tr: yağmurda satıcı az, fiyatlar daha iyi. örtülü tezgahlara bak, öğleden önce git.

sparks.why: Rain and 7–13°C on Wednesday 28.10 (wetter.com, DWD) — covered stalls only; market hours Mon–Sat, so open on a Wednesday.

title.en: skate under a roof or not at all.
title.de: skaten unter dach oder gar nicht.
title.tr: çatı altında kaymak ya da hiç.

line.en: wet concrete is no fun. find a covered spot or an indoor hall; the outdoor parks are closed to common sense today.
line.de: nasser beton macht keinen spaß. such dir einen überdachten platz oder eine halle; draußen ist heute nicht sinnvoll.
line.tr: ıslak beton zevk vermez. örtülü bir yer ya da salon bul; dışarıdaki parklar bugün akıl işi değil.

sparks.why: Rain and 7–13°C on Wednesday 28.10 (wetter.com, DWD) — outdoor skating unsafe on wet concrete, so a hall.

title.en: cook together tonight.

line.en: rain makes a pot of something slow the right plan. buy at the viktualienmarkt on the way, cook with friends, eat before the match.
line.de: bei regen ist ein topf mit etwas langsamem genau richtig. unterwegs am viktualienmarkt einkaufen, mit freunden kochen, vor dem spiel essen.
line.tr: yağmurda yavaş pişen bir tencere doğru plan. yolda viktualienmarkt'tan alışveriş yap, arkadaşlarla pişir, maçtan önce ye.

sparks.why: Rain and 7–13°C on Wednesday 28.10 (wetter.com, DWD) — slow-cooking suits the weather.

title.en: sauna while it rains.

line.en: 12 degrees and wet is the best sauna weather. a half hour in, cold plunge, rest, repeat. therme erding is open late.
line.de: zwölf grad und nass ist das beste saunawetter. eine halbe stunde rein, kaltes tauchbecken, ruhen, wiederholen. die therme erding hat lange auf.
line.tr: oniki derece ve ıslak en iyi sauna havası. yarım saat içeride, soğuk havuz, dinlenme, tekrar. therme erding geç saate kadar açık.

sparks.why: Rain and 7–13°C on Wednesday 28.10 (wetter.com, DWD) — cold and wet — peak sauna weather.

title.en: open mic, three minutes each.
title.de: open mic, drei minuten pro person.
title.tr: open mic, kişi başı üç dakika.

line.en: a small stage, a room that is warm, and a wednesday with nothing else on for the poets and the guitar people.
line.de: eine kleine bühne, ein warmer raum und ein mittwoch, an dem sonst nichts los ist, für dichter und gitarrenleute.
line.tr: küçük bir sahne, sıcak bir oda ve şairlerle gitar çalanlar için başka işi olmayan bir çarşamba.

sparks.why: Rain and 7–13°C on Wednesday 28.10 (wetter.com, DWD) — indoors, nothing special on.

title.en: table tennis, loser buys.

line.en: an indoor table, a bad rainy evening and two rackets. first to eleven, loser buys the drinks.
line.de: eine tischtennisplatte drinnen, ein mieser regenabend und zwei schläger. bis elf, der verlierer gibt die runde aus.
line.tr: kapalı bir masa, berbat bir yağmurlu akşam ve iki raket. on bire kadar, kaybeden içkileri öder.

sparks.why: Rain and 7–13°C on Wednesday 28.10 (wetter.com, DWD) — indoor sport for a rainy evening.

title.en: bouldering out of the rain.

line.en: a hall full of walls and chalk. busiest after work, so come at seven and expect to queue for the hard problems.
line.de: eine halle voller wände und magnesia. nach der arbeit am vollsten, also um sieben kommen und bei den schweren routen anstehen.
line.tr: duvarlar ve magnezyumla dolu bir salon. iş çıkışı en kalabalık, yedide gel ve zor rotalarda sıra bekle.

sparks.why: Rain and 7–13°C on Wednesday 28.10 (wetter.com, DWD) — indoor climbing.

title.en: an indoor picnic when it pours.
title.de: ein picknick drinnen, wenn es schüttet.

line.en: blanket on the floor of someone's flat, cheese, bread, whatever the market had. the hofgarten can wait for a dry day.
line.de: decke auf dem wohnzimmerboden, käse, brot, was der markt hergab. der hofgarten kann auf einen trockenen tag warten.
line.tr: birinin oturma odasında yere battaniye, peynir, ekmek, pazarda ne varsa. hofgarten kuru bir güne beklesin.

sparks.why: Rain and 7–13°C on Wednesday 28.10 (wetter.com, DWD) — outdoor picnic only works dry; moved to a flat.

title.en: a three-bar crawl before kick-off.
title.de: kneipentour mit drei stationen vor dem anpfiff.
title.tr: vuruştan önce üç duraklı bar turu.

line.en: start at 19:00 in the glockenbach, a drink at each, and end at a bar with the cup on by 20:45. bars are warm, streets are wet.
line.de: start um 19 uhr im glockenbach, ein getränk pro station, und um 20:45 in einer bar mit pokalspiel enden. drinnen warm, draußen nass.
line.tr: 19:00'da glockenbach'ta başla, her durakta bir içki, 20:45'te kupa maçının açık olduğu bir barda bitir. içerisi sıcak, sokaklar ıslak.

sparks.why: Bayern–Magdeburg kicks off 20:45 (DFB-Pokal); rain pushes the crawl between short indoor stops.

title.en: no stars tonight, cloud and rain.
title.de: heute keine sterne, wolken und regen.
title.tr: bu gece yıldız yok, bulut ve yağmur.

line.en: the sky is shut, so skip the olympiaberg. a planetarium evening, or a dark bar and the idea of stars, will do.
line.de: der himmel ist zu, also den olympiaberg auslassen. ein planetariumsabend oder eine dunkle bar mit dem gedanken an sterne tut es auch.
line.tr: gökyüzü kapalı, olympiaberg'i boş ver. planetaryum akşamı ya da yıldız fikriyle karanlık bir bar da olur.

sparks.why: Rain and 7–13°C on Wednesday 28.10 (wetter.com, DWD) — overcast, so stargazing is off; planetarium as the replacement (hours to be checked).

title.en: five-a-side in a hall, not on wet grass.
title.de: fünf gegen fünf in der halle, nicht auf nassem rasen.
title.tr: ıslak çimde değil, salonda beşe beş.

line.en: rain turns the pitch to mud. book a small indoor court for 18:00, play an hour, and be home for the cup at 20:45.
line.de: regen macht den platz zum matsch. kleine halle für 18 uhr buchen, eine stunde spielen und zum pokal um 20:45 zu hause sein.
line.tr: yağmur sahayı çamura çevirir. 18:00'e küçük bir salon ayır, bir saat oyna, 20:45'te kupa için evde ol.

sparks.why: Rain makes the outdoor pitch unplayable; Bayern's cup match at 20:45 (fussballnationalmannschaft.net).

title.en: ride the tram end to end in the rain.
title.de: tram bis zur endstation im regen.

line.en: line 19 from the east to the west, window seat, lights smeared by the rain. cheap and warm.
line.de: linie 19 von osten nach westen, fensterplatz, regenverschmierte lichter. billig und warm.
line.tr: 19 numaralı hat doğudan batıya, cam kenarı, yağmurda dağılan ışıklar. ucuz ve sıcak.

sparks.why: Rain and 7–13°C on Wednesday 28.10 (wetter.com, DWD) — a warm ride is the weather-proof plan; dark by 17:02.

title.en: jazz in a small room.

line.en: a basement club, a trio, and rain on the street above. the late set starts at half past eight.
line.de: ein kellerclub, ein trio und oben der regen auf der straße. das späte set beginnt um halb neun.
line.tr: bir bodrum kulübü, bir trio ve üstte sokakta yağmur. geç set sekiz buçukta başlıyor.

sparks.why: Rain and 7–13°C on Wednesday 28.10 (wetter.com, DWD) — indoor late set; programme to be checked on the day.

title.en: a short walk to the last grey light.
title.de: ein kurzer spaziergang ins letzte graue licht.
title.tr: son gri ışığa kısa bir yürüyüş.

line.en: sunset is at 17:02, so go at four. an umbrella, a river bridge and back for tea.
line.de: sonnenuntergang ist um 17:02, also um vier los. schirm, eine brücke über den fluss und zurück zum tee.
line.tr: gün batımı 17:02, o yüzden dörtte çık. şemsiye, nehirde bir köprü ve çaya geri dön.

sparks.why: Rain and 7–13°C on Wednesday 28.10 (wetter.com, DWD) — light rain, sunset 17:02.
